claims.claim: B said they were only going to get a few things
claims.mechanism: reported speech presupposition in 'I thought you said'

evidence.quote: I thought you said you were only going to get a few things

claims.verifier_basis: 'I thought you said X' is a reporting clause that linguistically entails B made statement X; the alternative (B never said it) renders A's accusation incoherent.

claims.claim: B is picking out a lipstick
claims.mechanism: direct address question presupposing the activity

evidence.quote: How long does it take you to pick out a lipstick

claims.verifier_basis: Rhetorical question presupposes B is currently picking out a lipstick, supported by context of being in a store for an hour.

claims.claim: B is picking out some nail polish
claims.mechanism: direct address question presupposing the activity

evidence.quote: How long does it take you to pick out a lipstick and some nail polish

claims.verifier_basis: Rhetorical question presupposes B is picking out nail polish, same mechanism as c2.

claims.claim: B has been shopping for almost an hour

evidence.quote: We have been here for almost an hour !

claims.verifier_basis: A directly states they have been there almost an hour; 'we' includes B, and context confirms shopping activity.

claims.claim: B has selected multiple small items, exceeding the few things originally stated
claims.mechanism: A's reaction to 'all this' and 'each one of these little things' implies B accumulated many items

evidence.quote: How much is all this going to cost ? I ’ m looking at the price at each one of these little things
I thought you said you were only going to get a few things !

claims.verifier_basis: Turn 7 shows multiple small items exist (B selected them); turn 5 establishes B had said 'a few things', so the quantity exceeds that expectation.

claims.claim: B is shopping at a cosmetics/beauty store
claims.mechanism: lipstick, nail polish, and 'crayon' (slang for lipstick) in context

evidence.quote: How long does it take you to pick out a lipstick and some nail polish !

claims.verifier_basis: Lipstick and nail polish are cosmetics/beauty products; combined with 'these little things' and 'thirty dollar crayon' (turn 7), the store context is clearly a cosmetics/beauty retailer.

claims.claim: B wants to buy a thirty-dollar item that A refers to as a crayon
claims.mechanism: imperative directed at B presupposes B's intent to buy

evidence.quote: Get the stupid thirty dollar crayon !

claims.repair_of: B wants to buy a thirty-dollar item that A refers to as a crayon (likely a lip liner)
claims.verifier_basis: A's concession 'Fine! Get...' in turn 9 presupposes B's desire to purchase the item; the 'thirty dollar crayon' description is A's own characterization from turns 7 and 9.

claims.claim: B was insisting on buying the thirty-dollar item, prompting A's reluctant concession
claims.mechanism: concessive marker 'Fine!' indicates B was actively pushing for the purchase against A's objection

evidence.quote: Fine ! Get the stupid thirty dollar crayon !

claims.verifier_basis: 'Fine!' is a concession marker implying B pushed/insisted on the purchase; 'stupid' confirms A's displeasure; imperative 'Get...' directed at B confirms B was trying to acquire the item.
